scope: The head was selected using exploratory seeds12000/12001, then frozen for eight additional development seeds12002..12009 per arm. Report partitions separately; combined10 is descriptive, not an independent test.
selection_and_tuning: No head or runtime changes during extension, and no further tuning using extension outcomes. Reserved13000-series outcomes were not used for learner selection.
limits: Eight new episodes per arm provide an imprecise reliability estimate. Wilson95% intervals summarize binomial sampling uncertainty, not environment-model or sim-to-real uncertainty.
Initial2 episodes helped select this candidate and are not an independent test. Combined10 includes those exploratory episodes.
Visibility means detected at the latest5-tick refresh; RGB fits the declared table support plane and retains unobserved targets, without verified carried-object tracking.
Phase is inferred intended motion, not measured grasp. Simulator held/lifted/object positions are scoring-only audit inputs.
The later empty-pickup teacher replan fix postdates collection; it cannot improve these already-trained heads without new labels and training.
A lost-held event while jaw intent is closed does not alone establish the mechanical cause of losing the ball. It distinguishes retention failures from explicit opening commands.
source_set_contract: Each exact source map is shared_runtime_source_sha256 merged with source_sets[source_set_id]; source_set_id is SHA256 of sorted-key JSON of that full map.
findings: The fixed extension completed 2/8 tasks on each arm (25%; Wilson 95% interval 7.15%..59.07%). The exploratory 2 trials completed 1/2 per arm. Combined descriptive performance is 3/10 per arm (30%), below 60%.
There were no aborted phase trials across 20 episodes; all requested seeds remain in their denominators and all 20 videos match trace lengths and decode their final frame.

Panda lifted the ball while held in 7/8 extension tasks, but five failed transport. At the final loss of held status in each of those five, jaw intent was closed (open fraction<.013), the phase prediction was LIFT, and the ball remained roughly 31–34cm XY from the bowl. This supports grasp-retention/motion robustness as a bottleneck, rather than an explicit release command.

SO101 extension failures split into 3 transport, 2 approach and 1 grasp; all transport failures had real held/lifted evidence before loss. One loses near the bowl while regressing to PRE_GRASP/open intent, showing inconsistent inferred progression as well as retention failures.
The head is experimental. These fixed-head tests do not support promoting it over the RGB geometric controller, whose separate matched benchmark completed 100/100 per arm.
external_artifact_integrity_note: Binary/model/cache artifacts referenced externally by execution manifests were also read and SHA256-verified during this audit; copied source files were verified against their frozen snapshots.
